name: SmartDoc 2015 Challenge 2 (smartphone document OCR)
description: Smartphone photos of printed English documents taken under varying conditions (blur, perspective, lighting), with the ground-truth text of each document.
redistribution: yes, with attribution; not redistributed here
size: testDataset.zip 26.6 GB: 35 documents, 8,470 images (sampleDataset.zip 12.2 GB not used)

split.group_by: source document (identical ground-truth text file: CRC-32 and size from the zip directory)

download_status_here: not downloaded here: host not reachable from the sandbox (zenodo.org)
notes: The main public source of hard-condition phone photos with full text ground truth.
Several photos per source document: the converter must split by source document (all captures of one document in the same split) to keep held-out unseen.
Split by source document (iris-split/1-grouped): the run stops if grouping does not give the 35 test documents.
Folder and file naming inside testDataset.zip are not documented publicly; the planner pairs images and text files by stem and fails loudly otherwise.

pack.page_addressing: page ID = image file stem; ground truth = the .txt member with the same stem (one UTF-8 text file per image)

estimate.how: range reads: central directory (~17k entries, ~2 MB) + 75 phone photos (~3.1 MB each: 26.6 GB / 8,470); the whole archive is never downloaded
